decisions.reason: Having been retained once already, this own-page extension of the core platform carries accumulated development investment and visible commitment, so any weaker uptake would likely still be treated as temporary.
Its gas focus is narrower, but it remains close to the firm's tariff and market-data capabilities and its separate presentation makes management inclined to continue rather than reverse course.
This calculator sits squarely in the firm's core calculation and data domain, and a second year on the market increases sunk-cost and justification pressures to keep it.
As an enabling tool for integrated workflows it supports the announced platform strategy, and after already backing it publicly management is likely to persist unless performance clearly collapses.

Although less visibly committed on the website and somewhat comparable to the dropped multi-model line, it is still close to the established offer and management can plausibly attribute any shortfall to slow market adoption.
